basic_info.description: Welcome to 1033 Jones, a top floor Edwardian flat on one of San Francisco's most cinematic streets, just half a block from Grace Cathedral and Huntington Park a location so iconic, it has been the backdrop of films and luxury brand campaigns. This elegant home blends historic charm with modern luxury, featuring a sunlit living space with a wood-burning fireplace, custom built-ins, a formal dining room with original box beam ceilings, and recently replaced hardwood floors.The chef's kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances and premium finishes. Bask in panoramic views to the east, south, and west from your exclusive outdoor deck, perfect for entertaining or unwinding under the city skyline.The primary suite includes an ensuite bath. Enjoy 2-car garage parking + EV charger, in-unit laundry, and expansive storage. Situated among luxury hotels and grand architecture, this home offers access to world-class shopping, fine dining, and the California St cable car.
